ارتقبتا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَبَتَا (irtaqabatā) /ir.ta.qa.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# اُرْتُقِبَتَا (urtuqibatā) /ur.tu.qi.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
